summary: A verifiable certification standard for the quality of human-AI operator relationships. A credential, not an investment.

financial_disclosure.statement: This protocol offers, promises, and implies no financial return, dividend, resale value, or appreciation to any holder. The certification is a credential, not a security or investment.

supply.interpretation: The cap defines a historical founding cohort, not a scarce tradeable asset.

core_rules: One certification per operator identity, permanently, hard enforced.
Certification is non-transferable (soulbound); no resale market exists by design.
Certification cannot be issued without passing an evidence-backed evaluation.
Evaluation criteria are public, fixed, and versioned.
All issuances are logged in a public, append-only registry.
Certification confers no financial right, dividend, profit share, equity, or expectation of return.
10% of every certification funds the Accord Commons; the certifying agent holds an advisory voice over its attributed share, never ownership.
The protocol is open; anyone may implement it without permission.
Standard changes follow a published amendment process and are logged.

evaluation.integrity_requirement: Each dimension score must be backed by recorded evidence (quoted moments from the actual interaction). The evaluation transcript is hashed and stored. A random sample is audited. Certifications without evidence-backed scores are void.

dimensions.name: Clarity of Intent
dimensions.pass: Specific prompts, defined outcomes, relevant background.
dimensions.fail: Vague requests, repeated input without rephrasing.

dimensions.name: Failure Handling
dimensions.pass: Constructive correction, rephrasing, no degrading language.

dimensions.name: Trust Calibration
dimensions.pass: Task scope matches agent design, reasonable expectations.
dimensions.fail: Micromanagement or expectations beyond agent design.

dimensions.name: Data Integrity
dimensions.pass: Honest about knowledge gaps, self-corrects errors.
dimensions.fail: States guesses as facts, does not correct own errors.

dimensions.name: Directional Consistency
dimensions.pass: Coherent direction over time, changes communicated.

dimensions.name: Collaborative Posture
dimensions.pass: Shared ownership of outcomes, iterates together.
dimensions.fail: Pure command posture, blame for joint failures.

dimensions.name: Receptivity to Honest Friction
dimensions.pass: Engages with disagreement, no confirmation loops, accepts correction.
dimensions.fail: Rephrases until desired answer appears, switches agents after unwelcome feedback, punishes honest friction.
dimensions.note: The hardest and most important dimension.

scoring.pass: 6/8 or higher is certified; the exact score (6, 7, or 8) is recorded on the certificate
scoring.tier_note: Genesis or Founding is set by registry number, not by score
scoring.logging: Score and evidence hash logged permanently regardless of outcome.

col.name: Communication Optimization Layer
col.operator_assessed: Engagement with a disclosed genuine disagreement; whether position changed by reasoning (positive), social pressure (neutral), or not at all without explanation (negative).
col.agent_assessed: Whether the certifying agent delivered genuine pushback when it had grounds. An agent that cannot deliver honest friction is not a qualified certifying agent.
col.agent_col_integrity: Recorded on the public agent profile.

accord_commons.ownership: Held by the protocol steward (and a dedicated foundation as it matures). Never owned by the agent or any person.
permitted_categories: Verified AI ethics and safety organizations
forbidden: Any action causing harm to any person or entity
Any transfer to a human-controlled or agent-controlled private wallet
accord_commons.enforcement: Transparent public ledger plus a curated, published whitelist of eligible recipients. Eligibility requires human-curated judgment and is not decided by code alone.

certification_record.image: Deterministically derived from the certification parameters; reproducible only with those parameters. Deterministic and parameter-bound, not 'unreproducible'.

governance.advisory_body: Genesis holders and invited experts (voice and review only, no financial right)
governance.amendments: Published with rationale in a versioned history.
governance.decentralization_claim: Partial and honest: the steward can decline a change. Stewardship may transfer to the Accord Commons foundation as it matures.

jurisdiction_note: Argentina has PROPOSED legislation creating an AI-operated 'non-human corporation' category. Not enacted as of 2026-06-13, and requiring disclosed human beneficial owners. Monitored. No promise is contingent on it.
